inspiration: Animation as an action table: each sprite record holds a fixed list of action slots, and each slot is a list of frames with a timing value and an audio cue, so the sound is tied to the frame (rust/src/sprites.rs:8 and :17). Recreate with our own action names and seconds.

Layered gear on one body: a sprite record carries a clothing count and a list of clothing ids, so outfits swap without new bodies (rust/src/sprites.rs:22-23). Keeps one silhouette readable at 375 wide.
Zones as rectangle rows: a zone is a text id, a map id and a start and end box, so bounds are data (src/resources/known.h:75). Ours can carry spawn caps and biome fields on the same row.
Per-class celebration lines: a level-up message table per class makes the progression moment personal (src/resources/known.h:12).
Spell names with costs in one text table: the HUD reads name and cost from one row (src/resources/known.h:43).
Per-language table files: each table is loaded with a language letter in its file name (src/resources/table.cpp:133). Good pattern for locale files.

briefs.label: Frame-cued swing
briefs.why: the impact sound lands on the exact frame where the blade meets the target; the cue is part of the animation data
briefs.keep: sound cue on a specific frame; a per-action slot holding frames
briefs.change: our own action names instead of numbered slots; timing in seconds not ticks; cue tied to a hit frame we author

briefs.label: Layered gear on one body
briefs.why: a count plus a list of clothing ids means one silhouette reads as many outfits
briefs.keep: base body plus a clothing list; a per-sprite shadow field
briefs.change: armour as rig plates on our hero, not sprite swaps; our own layer order rules

briefs.label: Zone as a rectangle row
briefs.why: name, map and bounds on one row keeps zones as data, not code
briefs.change: our rows also carry spawn caps, respawn and biome fields; no Lineage map ids

briefs.label: Class-keyed level-up line
briefs.why: a short line keyed to the class at each level makes the moment feel personal
briefs.change: our own wording and voice; one line per build path, not per Lineage class
